periods.time: After most escaped prisoners are recaptured

name.zh: 日本分部解除特别徵召

periods.location: International Mage-Knight League Japan Branch, Tokyo
periods.summary: The League Japan Branch thanks thirty student knights from Hagun and Donrou for emergency service, announces that special conscription is over, and pays them daily compensation. In the showers, Toka, Kanata, Ayase and Oreki discuss the stress of real combat, Ikki's world-level achievements, and plans for summer break.
periods.cause: Japan's crisis has stabilized enough that professional mage-knights can handle remaining fugitives without student authority.
periods.process: Students attend a debrief, receive pay and compensatory vacation, and begin returning to normal life. Toka and Kanata decide to go back to Fukuoka/Wakaba House, while Ayase reflects on Ikki's sword instruction and Oreki resolves to congratulate Ikki properly.
periods.outcome: The volume shifts from national emergency to personal aftermath, setting up Toka's homecoming and Moroboshi's chance meeting with Kuraudo.
periods.significance: Connects the emergency-response arc to the Moroboshi spar and the Wakaba House arc.
